Для ракиа в обоих слоях взято «свод», а не Синодальное «твердь»: церковнославянское слово несёт оттенок твёрдости, как латинское firmamentum, которого еврейский корень не требует. «Твердь» названа в комментарии и заметке.
В драматическом слое «сделал» (асá) вместо «сотворил», чтобы «сотворил» осталось за глаголом бара; буквальный слой и комментарий без изменений.

notes.note: Verse coverage: Gen 1:1–31 are all covered. The seventh day (Gen 2:1–3) belongs to chapter 2 and is not written here; its session should anchor on evt.gen_1.day6_land_life END.

The six days are chained one after another, each starting at EREV (the Hebrew day runs sunset to sunset: 'there was evening and there was morning', 1:5) and lasting 24 hours, all from anchor.creation (Anno Mundi 1). The chain is exact as the text tells it; the commentaries raise the debate about what a day is (Ramban: the first light served three days, Ibn Ezra: a day is a turn of the sphere; Radak/Rashi: days of the Torah's reckoning). I do not resolve it: the dates show the text's six-day order, not the age of the earth.

Divine speeches checked for fulfilment: each 'Let there be … and it was so' (1:3, 6–7, 9, 11–12, 14–17, 20–21, 24–25) is fulfilled in the same event, so no FULFILLS_PROPHECY link is written between events. 1:29–30 'I have given' is a gift in the present, not a prediction. 'Let us make' (1:26) is fulfilled at 1:27 in the same event.

[event:evt.gen_1.day1_light] Day one begins at EREV on the creation date, not with the light of 1:3: the formula 'evening and morning' counts the day from the evening. Rashi on 1:5 notes the text says 'one day', not 'first day'. Sforno and Ramban: before the luminaries (day 4) the alternation of light and darkness is not by the sun's circuit; I give it the same 24-hour frame.

[event:evt.gen_1.beginning] 1:1–2 is the state before day one (the earth waste and dark, the spirit hovering). It is given zero duration at the anchor. 1:1 may be read as a summary of the whole week (Rashi/YLT 'in the beginning of God's preparing'); I treat it as the opening scene, a judgment call.

[event:evt.gen_1.day3_land_sea] Day three has two acts with no stated gap: the waters gather, the plants sprout (1:9–12). I split them as children of the day, each about six hours with a 12-hour margin; their order is the text's, their lengths are an estimate and the tier stays DAY_SEQUENCE.

[event:evt.gen_1.day6_land_life] Day six is a parent with four beats (animals, humankind, food, the verdict). Their lengths are estimates; only the order and the day are in the text. 1:31 'very good' is placed in the last hour of the day (Radak citing Bereshit Rabbah 9:14), at offset 23 hours from the day's start, since a negative offset is not allowed; a gap of some hours after the food speech is left open by its margin.

[event:evt.gen_1.day6_humankind] 1:26 (the decision) and 1:27–28 (creation, blessing and command) are one event: the text marks no gap. The blessing's 'be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth' and the dominion of 1:26 are likely fulfilled in later chapters (Gen 4–10); the session of those chapters writes the link. Likewise 1:22's blessing of the sea creatures and birds (see 8:17, 9:1).

[causal:caus.gen_1.day6_land_animals.day6_humankind] Inferred (confidence 0.5): 1:26 names dominion over cattle and creeping things, which presupposes that they exist; the text does not say it is why they were made first.

[entity:loc.earth] Created world features (earth, heaven, seas) are modelled as LOCATION entities with no tipnr_id and no coordinates; they are cosmic, not geographic. Events are placed in them only as the setting of each act.

[entity:loc.heaven] 'The heavens' (1:1) and the firmament called Heaven (1:8) are merged into one entity, loc.heaven. Whether Gen 1:1 'heavens' is the same as the day-2 firmament is debated; the merge is a convenience.
[entity:loc.seas] Entity for the gathered waters, named at 1:10. The primeval deep/waters of 1:2 are not a separate entity.

[entity:substance.light] Light, darkness, luminaries and the creature groups are included because later acts of naming, separating, ruling and blessing target them. This goes slightly beyond 'objects the plot turns on'; the reviewer may prune.
[entity:artifact.greater_luminary] Entity type ARTIFACT is the nearest fit for the two luminaries (the text never names them 'sun' and 'moon'). Stars are left out as a mass of objects.
[entity:group.sea_and_air_creatures] Sea creatures and winged birds are one group because they are created and blessed together on day 5 (1:20-22).
[entity:group.humankind] Hebrew adam is collective (male and female, 1:27); modelled as one group, not as the individual Adam of Gen 2. Do not merge it with a later person.adam.
[event_links:evt.gen_1.day3_vegetation] The earth is marked AGENT because the text makes it the subject of 'brought forth' (1:12), though God's word commands it.

[event_links:evt.gen_1.day3_waters_gathered] The chronology has overlapping events for day 3 and day 6 (an umbrella event plus detail events). Participants are given to all of them alike, so umbrella events duplicate the detail rows.
[component:comp.earth.condition.1] Inferred state: the earth is 'formless and void' (1:2) until the waters are gathered and dry land appears (1:9-10). The second value ORDERED is an inference.
